The Friday before classes start. If it arrives by then, you're fine. Have you signed up for the buddy programme?

Hi Lais, it's Beatriz. Your mum gave the school my number because I did the same programme last year, so here is everything I wish somebody had told me. First, the paperwork. I sent my documents three weeks before I flew and I still ran out of time, so start now. Second, the transit pass. I didn't buy one in the first week because I thought my host family would drive me everywhere, and that was a mistake. Get it on day one. And third, orientation. I have never been so lost as I was that morning, mostly because I arrived exactly on time instead of early. Go early, find the hall, and then go and get a coffee. Message me whenever you want, honestly.

Hello, this is Peter Novak from the international student office. I'm calling about your file. I've received your school letter from Brazil and your passport copy, so those are done, thank you. There are two things still missing. The medical form has not arrived yet, and the deadline for that one is the Friday before classes start, so please ask your parents to send it this week. The second thing is the photo for your student card. You uploaded one last month, but it was too dark for the system to accept, so I'm afraid we need another one. Everything else looks great. See you at orientation.

The welcome letter arrives by email six weeks before the flight. Lais reads it and makes a list of every document the school asks for. She fills out the medical form and her father signs it. The school office confirms that the paperwork has arrived. On the first Monday she goes to orientation and picks up her student card.
